scope: Current development maicon26, one physical WINGBOT B-2, fixed MAICON arena, Gazebo Fortress, actual ROS camera/LiDAR/odom/IMU and 1 Hz UAV images
source_selection: No active_candidate.json; selected_runtime.py used the current development package

lidar.arena_static_obstacles: 14 fixed obstacles and 13 merged structure collisions are 0.4 m high; floor is 0.02 m thick. No sub-0.15 m obstacle is in this fixed layout.

runs.name: impact_off_first_attempt
runs.error: Aim diagnostic wrapper rejected the new t_obs keyword; wrapper fixed before completed retry

conclusion: The 0.15 m scan plane intersects every 0.4 m static structure in this layout. The first run's phantom invisible contacts are not evidence of a low obstacle: its Gazebo IMU impact threshold was uncalibrated. Gazebo trials now disable impact handling by default; --simulate-impact opts in. Real-robot impact configuration is unchanged.
limitations: The model scan height is derived from vendor SDF plus photo reconstruction, not a measured physical WINGBOT scan plane.
This arena contains no low obstacle, so physical detection of sub-0.15 m objects was not measured in these runs.
The M3 score requires exact counts per sector and class; reported count alone is not a face detection rate.
One-robot trial cannot validate M4 combat or M6 ranking accuracy.

verification.videos: both complete runs have H264 recording metadata and no missing frames
